_doc: P24 ledger (scripts/check-host-demands.mjs): every (file, demand) pair an install makes of the operator's platform, each pointing at the row of the platform-requirements table in docs/docs/deployment-kubernetes.mdx that says why and how to avoid it. Keyed on the pair, never a line. Only shrinks: a pair that disappears must be dropped.

entries.reason: creates the agent session store's own login role (ADR-0048) so agent-api never holds the admin credential; a pre-created role needs no CREATEROLE
creates the CRM's own login role (ADR-0047), limited to the CRM tables; only with crm.enabled; a pre-created role needs no CREATEROLE
SQL the operator's DBA runs by hand for the optional adoption panel's read-only Grafana login; no service runs it
flows' ensure-db initContainer creates the flows database when flows.databaseName differs from database.name; avoided by pre-creating it or sharing the main database
writes the meeting bots' seccomp profile (Chromium's user-namespace sandbox) onto every node bots may land on; off with runtime.botSandbox.installer.enabled=false
root only to write the root-owned kubelet seccomp directory: no capability, no escalation, read-only root filesystem
the kubelet reads Localhost seccomp profiles only from its own directory on the node
LiveKit (calls, off by default) needs the node's UDP media range; hostNetwork is its default and can be turned off
livekit.hostNetwork default (calls are off by default)
only with runtime.backend=docker (not the default): the runtime drives the node's container engine
the docker socket mount, only with runtime.backend=docker
the Compose runtime spawns bot and worker containers through the host's Docker socket
reads the socket's group into DOCKER_GID so the runtime reaches it as uid 10001; mounts nothing
one-shot key generators (network_mode none) run as 0:0 only to chown the generated keys to uid 10001, then exit
the docker backend's engine address (Compose, or the chart with runtime.backend=docker)
the docker backend talks to the engine's socket
agent worker containers keep CHOWN DAC_OVERRIDE FOWNER FSETID KILL SETGID SETUID (profiles.WORKER_CAPABILITIES) to run the model's tools as their own uid
the same worker capabilities on a spawned Pod; runtime.workloadScheduling.agentWorker.capabilities: [] keeps none
